notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable only after the initial save.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, tags, and note are editable, but URL is not.
REF-BM-07: List exposes the textual fields and tags, but uses an initial-letter avatar instead of a favicon.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable filters.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed or matched.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Items are fixed to newest-first date order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes render only a small Markdown subset (lists and links).
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved filter bundles exist.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
